periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Oblique orientation, tilted at approximately 45 degrees relative to the horizontal facial axis, sloping downward toward the muzzle.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elliptical/Ovoid, with the longitudinal axis approximately 1.5 times the length of the transverse axis.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Clear downward tapering toward the medial-inferior margin, creating a teardrop-like elongation.

dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Broad transverse band, occupying approximately 30% of the visible vertical torso from the shoulder to the mid-abdomen.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: Wide lateral separation, with the inter-pinna gap roughly double the width of a single ear unit.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Smooth, convex semicircular curvature at the superior margins.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive yellowish-brown chromatic staining across the ventral abdominal fur area.
